newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-NO BALLS? PLAY IT AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NO BALLS? PLAY IT AGAIN.

text.p: Two Italian amateur teams have been ordered to replay a match that ended prematurely when the players ran out of balls.
All three balls available went missing during the game between southern sides Ginestra and Ruvo after being kicked out of the ground. The referee had no alternative but to blow the whistle early.
The disciplinary committee of the Basilicata region of the Italian soccer federation said on Friday that the November 24 game should be played again.
